summary: A relaxed weekend of park mornings, a scenic hike and a shelter visit, with cooler weather finally on our side.
heatNote: Highs run about 81 to 88°F. Go out before 10 am or after 5 pm, bring water, and press the back of your hand on pavement for 7 seconds: if it is too hot for you, it is too hot for paws.

picks.name: City Hall Dog Park
picks.when: Saturday or Sunday, 7 to 9 am (open daily 6 am to 10 pm)
picks.where: Behind City Hall, 3200 E. Tahquitz Canyon Way, Palm Springs
picks.why: Morning regulars gather here, so it is the easiest place to meet the same dog owners week after week. There is a separate area for small dogs.
picks.check: Bring water and poop bags, and keep your dog's vaccines current before off leash play.

picks.name: Demuth Dog Park
picks.when: Any morning or evening, 6 am to dusk
picks.where: Demuth Park, along the CV Link, Palm Springs
picks.why: Pair a park visit with a walk on the CV Link path, where you will pass plenty of other walkers and their dogs.
picks.check: Closes at dusk, and the CV Link path heats up fast in the sun.

picks.name: Palm Springs Animal Shelter
picks.when: Saturday or Sunday, 11 am to 5 pm
picks.why: A great way to meet rescue minded locals and volunteers, and to find out about upcoming adoption events.
picks.check: Call ahead before bringing your own dog, since shelters often ask visitors to leave pets at home.

picks.name: Whitewater Preserve Canyon View Loop
picks.when: Saturday or Sunday, start by 8 am
picks.where: Whitewater Preserve, about 25 minutes northwest of Palm Springs
picks.why: A dog friendly 3.5 mile loop with mountain views, popular with hikers who bring their dogs.
picks.check: Confirm preserve hours and leash rules before you drive out, and carry plenty of water for both of you.
